svg.text: SCALE 20:1 · SM · INDEX LABELS ARE ANNOTATIONS
SQUARE CELLS; NO ROUNDING, BORDER OR SHADOW.
GRID IS A BLOCK. PARENT MAY STRETCH ITS TRACKS.
W0 IS THE COMPACT ENVELOPE, NOT A FIXED ROOT WIDTH.
SIXTEEN I ELEMENTS IN ROW-MAJOR ORDER.
FIXED FOUR COLUMNS AND FOUR ROWS.
SIZE CHANGES CELL AND GAP TOGETHER.
NO PADDING OR PAINTED ROOT SURFACE.
NO RESERVED BOX OR ACCESSIBLE STATUS.
LABEL ADDS ROLE STATUS AND A NAME.
WITHOUT LABEL THE ROOT IS ARIA-HIDDEN.
LAYER LIFT BELOW IS EXPLANATORY ONLY.
PROPORTIONAL · NO PHYSICAL DEPTH OR Z DIMENSION
TRACKS → CELL FILL → CSS OPACITY PHASE.
SCHEMATIC · DELAY RANK IN EACH CELL
LOCAL TIME = GLOBAL TIME − CELL DELAY
A1 → A2 → A1; REST UNTIL THE CYCLE ENDS.
POSITIVE DELAY: BEFORE FIRST START, OPACITY IS 1.
NO BACKWARDS FILL MODE; DELAY DOES NOT HIDE DOTS.
globals.css · cn utility · no behavior primitive
